headings.scale: fluid scaling up to text-6xl or text-7xl for hero impact (since it's a condensed font, text-7xl is acceptable but scale proportionally for mobile)
headings.usage: Use strictly for main section headers, hero titles, and large numbers.

body.scale: text-base for normal text, text-lg for subtitles
body.usage: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, tags, and all UI elements.

rules: No dark/black backgrounds for main sections. Ensure strict adherence to off-white/light theme.
Use #FF5A00 (Amber/Fire tone) for primary Call-to-Actions, active states, and energetic accents.
Maintain a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns to preserve legibility.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise or grain overlays on solid buttons or background sections to add a tactile 'editorial' feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Crisp 1px solid borders for structural elements (Bento Grids). Do not use soft fuzzy shadows. Use hard lines or solid color offsets.
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal rounded corners. Use rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-none for an edgy, professional publication look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard offset shadows or very subtle ambient shadows (shadow-sm). Avoid large blur spreads.

layouts_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-8, p-12, p-16 for section spacing. Allow elements to breathe.
layouts_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid System for Event/Artist discovery. Asymmetrical spans (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4).
layouts_and_spacing.hero_section: Editorial layout: Overlapping large typography, dynamic staggered layout, high-contrast imagery.
layouts_and_spacing.alignment: Prioritize left-alignment for dense text. Center-alignment only for dramatic hero statements or final CTAs.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Editorial Motion. Smooth, purposeful, staggered reveals.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images should scale up slightly (scale-105) inside hidden overflow containers. Buttons should have color fill sweeps or translate-y-1 effects.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered text reveals (framer-motion or simple CSS keyframes). Large headings sliding up from masked containers.
motion_and_interactions.libraries: framer-motion for interactions, react-fast-marquee for editorial ribbon/ticker tapes (e.g., announcing upcoming big events).

components.navigation: Sticky, backdrop-blur-xl with solid white/off-white background (e.g., bg-white/90). Must have clear links and Accent button.
components.buttons: Flat, solid colors. Primary CTA: bg-[#FF5A00] text-white hover:bg-[#E65100]. Secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-black text-black hover:bg-black hover:text-white.
components.cards: Flat design with 1px border. Image on top (aspect-video or square), clear bold typography below. Include tags for Event Type, Art Form, City.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form/Input components. Crisp borders, focus:ring-[#FF5A00]. Left-aligned labels.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for the Multi-step Booking Request form and registration flows. Ensure high contrast and close buttons are visible.
components.tabs_filters: Use Shadcn Tabs/Select. Make them look like pill-tags or clean underlined tabs. Highlight active tab with Accent color.

hero_and_events.description: Group of dancers, high energy, good for Event Discovery or Hero
Breakdancer freeze pose, great for Battle/Cypher event card

artists_and_music.description: DJ performing live, for Artist Directory or Music Event

classes_and_studios.description: Ballet dancers in motion, perfect for Classes & Workshops module

visual_arts.description: Painted wall with painting materials, for Graffiti/Visual Artists directory

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the off-white background passes WCAG AA minimums (4.5:1).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for staggered animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a light theme. DO NOT use dark mode or black backgrounds as requested by the user.
Implement bold editorial typography using Oswald for headers and Manrope for body text.
Apply the primary accent color #FF5A00 for CTAs, hovered states, and active navigational elements.

Leverage Shadcn UI components for complex interactions like modals (Booking Request), dropdowns, and form inputs, but strip away the default Vercel-look to match the crisp, solid-border aesthetic of the design.
Use framer-motion for smooth staggered reveals of text and bento grid elements on page load/scroll.
Ensure the layout mimics a high-end editorial publication: asymmetrical grids, generous whitespace, large typography, and sharp structural lines.
Images should have a subtle hover effect (scale up inside a hidden overflow wrapper).
Write components in .jsx or .js as per the project setup. No .tsx files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use sonner for toasts from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner (or install if needed).
